topic: Why a plumber's Google listing gets views but no calls (Step 1)
title: Clear CTA | Why Your Plumber Gets Views but No Calls
description: Clear CTA. From our full video: Why Your Plumber Gets Views but No Calls.

scenes.narration: Step 1: Make the call-to-action impossible to miss. Replace vague 'Contact' buttons with 'Call Now for Same-Day Service' or 'Book Emergency Leak Repair.' On your Google profile title and short description repeat the CTA once.

Example: Plumber wording to copy: 'Call now for same-day leak repairs — licensed plumber, free quote over phone.' Put that as the first line in the business description. People scan quickly; lead with the ask.
